x: Edmund Donovan had to cut short his visit to the U.K. last year. His wife, Daye, wrote to us on his behalf after he had had an operation on his hip; however, come Christmas we find him sending greetings in his own handwriting with a hope to visit us again this year.

At the end of January your President, Gordon Doubleday and Clive Shippen were invited to lunch by DAYE DONOVAN at her London hotel.
